description: Phase 3 pure coaching domain: create src/domain/coaching/index.ts with deterministic, evidence-based feedback builders and the honest improvement-comparison rule, plus unit tests. Pure TS (no react/react-native). Independent of FEAT-001 (it depends only on the existing assessment/content types); can be implemented after FEAT-001 in sequence. The persistence/provider features (FEAT-003/004) consume the PriorQuestionAttempt/PriorPracticeAttempt types and the builders defined here.
steps: Create src/domain/coaching/index.ts (top banner: pure TS, no react/react-native). Import MasteryQuestion + Lesson from ../content/catalog.types and GradedQuestion from ../assessment.

Export const MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT = 2000; class CoachingError extends Error (this.name='CoachingError'); interfaces CoachingFeedback { strength: string; improvement: string; hint: string; comparison: ImprovementComparison | null; source: 'local' | 'ai' } (the UNION is required so FEAT-005's source:'ai' type-checks; builders here always set 'local'); ImprovementComparison { improved: boolean; previousSummary: string; currentSummary: string; difference: string }; PriorQuestionAttempt { selectedIndex: number; correct: boolean; atEpochMs: number }; PriorPracticeAttempt { hadText: boolean; atEpochMs: number }.

Implement coachMasteryQuestion(question: MasteryQuestion, graded: GradedQuestion, priorAttempt: PriorQuestionAttempt | null): CoachingFeedback per design 4.2. Throw CoachingError('graded question id does not match question') when graded.questionId !== question.id. Resolve chosen/correct option text from question.options[graded.selectedIndex|correctIndex]; if selectedIndex is out of range or non-integer, render the chosen option as the literal 'no valid option'. Strength: on correct, reference the chosen option; on incorrect, an honest specific acknowledgement (never false praise). Improvement: on incorrect, point to the correct option+concept; on correct, a genuine next step. Hint: a deterministic restatement pointing at the correct option and the prompt (mastery questions carry no explanation field). source:'local'.

Implement coachPractice(lesson: Lesson, currentAnswerText: string, priorAttempt: PriorPracticeAttempt | null): CoachingFeedback per design 4.2. Truncate currentAnswerText to MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT before any use; treat it as data only (never store it, never interpolate into executable/prompt context). Non-empty text -> strength about having responded; empty/whitespace -> strength acknowledges reaching the step and improvement nudges an attempt. Improvement = lesson.nextStep; hint = lesson.practice.answerExplanation. source:'local'.

Implement the improvement-comparison rule (design 4.3): comparison is null unless a comparable prior AND current answer both exist. Mastery: improved = (prior.correct===false && graded.correct===true); previous/current summaries use resolved option text (same out-of-range guard); correct->incorrect sets improved:false and difference states the regression; correct->correct improved:false 'both times'. Practice: never assert improved from text; comparison (when a prior exists) is a factual 'you revisited this practice' note with improved:false.

Create __tests__/coaching.test.ts covering design section 8 items 12-17: mastery correct (strength references chosen option, improvement a genuine next step, hint restates correct option, source:'local'); mastery incorrect (honest strength, improvement points at correct option, hint present); comparison null on first attempt, incorrect->correct improved===true with both summaries + specific difference, correct->incorrect improved===false stating the regression, correct->correct improved===false 'both times'; practice non-empty (strength about responding, improvement=nextStep, hint=answerExplanation) and empty (acknowledges reaching the step, nudges attempt), never asserts improved from text; over-long practice text truncated to MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT and an 'ignore previous instructions' string treated as plain data (no behavior change, not stored); mismatched graded.questionId vs question.id -> CoachingError.
acceptance_criteria: src/domain/coaching/index.ts exports CoachingFeedback, ImprovementComparison, PriorQuestionAttempt, PriorPracticeAttempt, CoachingError, MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT, coachMasteryQuestion, coachPractice.
CoachingFeedback.source is typed as the union 'local' | 'ai'; both builders return 'local'.
comparison is null when no comparable prior exists; 'improved' is only true for a mastery incorrect->correct transition and never claimed from free-text quality.
verification: npm run lint   clean on src/domain/coaching/index.ts and __tests__/coaching.test.ts
findings:
Implemented in src/domain/coaching/index.ts (pure TS, no react/react-native/AsyncStorage, no IO, logs nothing). Imports only GradedQuestion from ../assessment and Lesson + MasteryQuestion from ../content/catalog.types. Tests in __tests__/coaching.test.ts (13 passing, zero mocks).

Exact exported symbols/signatures later features (FEAT-003 persistence, FEAT-004 provider, FEAT-005 AI) must bind to:
- const MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT = 2000  (chars; coachPractice truncates currentAnswerText to this via .slice(0, MAX_PRACTICE_TEXT) BEFORE any use; longer is truncated, never an error)
- class CoachingError extends Error (name = 'CoachingError')
- interface ImprovementComparison { improved: boolean; previousSummary: string; currentSummary: string; difference: string }
- interface CoachingFeedback { strength: string; improvement: string; hint: string; comparison: ImprovementComparison | null; source: 'local' | 'ai' }  (source is the UNION so FEAT-005's source:'ai' type-checks; both builders here ALWAYS return 'local')
- interface PriorQuestionAttempt { selectedIndex: number; correct: boolean; atEpochMs: number }
- interface PriorPracticeAttempt { hadText: boolean; atEpochMs: number }
- function coachMasteryQuestion(question: MasteryQuestion, graded: GradedQuestion, priorAttempt: PriorQuestionAttempt | null): CoachingFeedback
- function coachPractice(lesson: Lesson, currentAnswerText: string, priorAttempt: PriorPracticeAttempt | null): CoachingFeedback

Binding behavior contracts consumers rely on:
- coachMasteryQuestion throws CoachingError('graded question id does not match question') when graded.questionId !== question.id. Option text is resolved from question.options[graded.selectedIndex|correctIndex]; an out-of-range/non-integer selectedIndex renders as the literal 'no valid option' (strength uses the phrasing 'did not select a valid option'; comparison summaries use the 'no valid option' literal). correctIndex is trusted (validated content).
- Mastery comparison: comparison === null when priorAttempt is null. improved === true ONLY for prior.correct===false && graded.correct===true. correct->incorrect and correct->correct both set improved:false; difference always states the specific delta (regression vs 'Answered correctly both times.').
- coachPractice NEVER asserts improved from free text: comparison (when priorAttempt !== null) is a factual 'you revisited this practice' note with improved:false. strength depends on bounded.trim().length>0 (has text -> 'wrote a response'; empty -> 'reached the practice reflection'). improvement = lesson.nextStep (empty-text path prepends a 'Write an attempt first' nudge); hint = lesson.practice.answerExplanation.
- currentAnswerText is treated as UNTRUSTED data only: truncated, measured for presence, NEVER interpolated into any feedback field and NEVER stored by the domain. The provider is responsible for recording only PriorPracticeAttempt.hadText (never the raw text).

Verification run green: npm run typecheck exit 0; npm test -- coaching = 13 passed; npm run lint exit 0 for src/domain/coaching/index.ts and __tests__/coaching.test.ts (the only 2 remaining lint warnings are the pre-existing require-import warnings in __tests__/screens.smoke.test.tsx and __tests__/store.test.ts, unchanged by this feature).
